title: Magazine: Made in the USA - Pharmaceutical Technology
summary: The latest issue of Pharmaceutical Technology Focus examines a renewed emphasis on US pharmaceutical manufacturing driven by government incentives, supply-chain disruption and geopolitical tensions. Features include an interview with Misumi Americas' CEO on US strategy, coverage of celebrity brand ambassadors in pharma advertising, AI governance in hospital pharmacies, and how national security concerns are reshaping US–China pharma relations.
content:
In this issue: Misumi Americas makes US manufacturing strategic priority, the celebrity brand ambassador rise in pharma, AI in the hospital pharmacy, and more.

A combination of US government incentives, supply chain disruptions, and geopolitical tensions are prompting increased investment in US manufacturing. In this month’s cover story, we spoke to Misumi Americas CEO Dave Evans to learn more about why the US is now a strategic priority for the company.

Also in this issue, we explore how celebrity ambassadors are shifting the nature of direct-to-consumer advertising in the pharma industry, and how US national security priorities are reshaping pharma relationships between the US and China.

Don’t miss our exclusive interview with Swisslog on the key AI governance considerations for the technology’s application in the hospital pharmacy.

Read the latest issue of Pharma Technology Focus for all this and insights and analysis from the pharmaceutical industry.

Find out more about how a combination of market forces, policy incentives and supply-chain realignment is encouraging manufacturers to reconsider onshore production, and what that means for procurement, compliance and strategic partnerships in pharma.
